verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST Developer API, a published OpenAPI schema, an open-source CLI and hosted MCP servers, but no official language SDK or client library. The OpenAPI schema is only a building block a developer could use to generate a client, and the CLI and MCP servers are separate capabilities that belong to other stories, so none of them earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
